Meet ZARI.

We are building a house of hand-knotted rugs rooted in Indian craftsmanship and made for timeless homes.

The first collection is still taking shape. Follow @zarirugs to see the decisions, materials and hands behind its making.

#ZARIRugs #IndianCraft #HandKnottedRugs #TimelessInteriors

The work lives in the details.

Tension, spacing, repetition—each line built by hand. As we shape ZARI's first collection, we keep returning to what the loom teaches: patience before pattern.

#ZARIRugs #MadeByHand #TextileCraft #RugMaking

A rug is never one colour.

Pile shifts with every change in light, revealing texture and then hiding it again. That quiet movement is part of what makes a room feel alive.

Would you choose deep shadow or sunlit texture?

#ZARIRugs #MaterialStudy #TextileDesign #LightAndTexture
